company.name: BiggerPicture
company.shortDescription: Bigger Picture is an online scheduling platform that connects warehousing, shipping, and transportation providers to improve supply chain.
company.description: BiggerPicture provides a SaaS solution to optimize scheduling between shippers, transportation, and consignees, drastically reducing assessorial costs and delays. They connect providers and warehouses to coordinate and optimize the movement of goods throughout the supply chain.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that automates scheduling of freight shipments by connecting shippers, carriers, and warehouses to coordinate inbound and outbound appointments.
productsAndServices.name: Appointment Scheduling Automation

productsAndServices.description: A scheduling system that uses AI and predictive analytics to optimize shipment appointment times and synchronize planning among supply chain stakeholders.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Scheduling

productsAndServices.description: A system that monitors shipments in real-time, detects risks or disruptions, and suggests corrective actions to maintain supply chain resilience and agility.
productsAndServices.name: Adaptive Execution Management

productsAndServices.description: A collaboration platform that provides real-time data sharing and a unified view of the appointment execution process among all supply chain partners.
productsAndServices.name: Synchronized Partner Coordination
